item.title: I Learned to Mend Jeans
item.description: I wear jeans a lot. This comes with the consequence that, while durable, denim wears down over time. In my case, that means three pairs of jeans each with a hole in the left knee. There seems to be a pattern here that needs some addressing. Two of those three pairs have gotten pretty bad recently, nearing the point of unwearable in public. I certainly wasn't going to toss three otherwise good pairs of jeans, so I decided to learn how to mend them.

item.title: My Study Abroad Experience in Aruba
item.description: Since I was young, I've always heard my parents talk about their outstanding study abroad experiences in college. I just got the opportunity to have an unforgettable abroad experience of my own.

item.title: Getting Off My Phone
item.description: I used to spend a large chunk of time on my phone, and I gained little benefit or satisfaction from it. Spending upwards of 4 hours per day on my phone was common. Whenever I had a quick break, I was pulled my phone out. Now, I've effectively stripped usage of my phone to under 2 hours per week, and I feel so much better for it.

item.title: Asking for Help
item.description: After my radio broke, I reached out to my local radio club for help, and got far more than I expected.

item.title: Why Learn Vim? And How?
item.description: I often find myself recommending Vim to my peers at Oregon State University. I have created this document as a reference to direct people to in order to help them discover and gain proficiency with Vim.
